name: Roofline: An Insightful Visual Performance Model for Floating-Point Programs and Multicore Architectures
notes: Communications of the ACM, vol 52 no 4. The canonical arithmetic-intensity roofline model: attainable performance = min(peak FLOPS, memory bandwidth x operational intensity). Establishes that a kernel with AI below the machine's balance point is bandwidth-bound no matter how fast the multiply units are.
